verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official GitHub repository of OpenAPI (Swagger) descriptions as OAS YAML files, with an OAuth 2.0 security schema. Xero uses these same files to generate its SDKs, so they are a maintained, machine-readable spec that can be downloaded directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness across all Xero API sets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository holds the official Xero OpenAPI descriptions.
An OpenAPI (Swagger) specification for the Xero API with OAuth 2.0 security schema.
We are using OpenAPI generator along with these OAS yaml files to generate our new SDKs.
